title: Size of the Universal Circuit
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $f$ a Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables. The universal circuit representing $f$ has size $(n+1)$ times the number of assignments on which $f$ is true, plus one.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps assignments of $n$ Boolean variables to a Boolean value
